neutral.prompt:
Surgical eye-direction edit of this exact existing full-body elderly female anthropomorphic BEAVER character portrait. ONE image, exactly 1024 x 1536 RGBA transparent PNG. Modify ONLY the orange-brown iris and black pupil placement inside the two existing eye whites so BOTH eyes look DIRECTLY toward camera/the father speaking to her. Move the currently upward/sideward-looking irises to the natural centered eye-contact position within each tilted eye. Respect perspective of the tilted head so eyes converge on viewer, not cross-eyed. Keep original eyelid contours, eye size, eye whites, gray eyebrows, expression, nose, tooth, smile/mouth, head tilt and face silhouette exactly unchanged. Do NOT turn the head to face front. Everything outside the two iris/pupil regions must stay as close to original pixel position as possible: preserve all fur, ears, gray hair braid/buns, patchwork olive shawl with exact fringes and patches, ivory blouse and buttons, blue skirt and patch, hands and arm pose, tail crosshatching, boots, foot placement, full-body framing and silhouette. Do not redraw, restyle, resize, move, simplify, recenter or crop character. Do not invent any cane or other prop. The existing original style and shading are authoritative. Original transparent background must remain empty; outer edges must contain NO background color, haze, glow, white sticker border, ground shadow or stray pixels. All four canvas corners must be fully transparent alpha ZERO. Preserve entire hair/ears/boots/tail without cutting. No text, no layout, no sheet.
Preserve exactly the original neutral expression and hand pose in this particular reference; do not substitute another expression.
